notes: Regenerated after the designer reorganized the Figma file with clean sequential frame numbers ('1', '2', '4.1', '15.1.1', etc.) and gave numbered interaction instructions, plus asked to follow the 'Lydia' design system strictly. This update REPLACED most of the CBR wizard's middle section — many frames from the previous round (routes A/B/C/D/E, the old Enroll Accounts 1-7, Master vendor 103, the external-site mock) no longer exist in the Figma file at all and were deleted. The flow is now much shorter (17 screens total, down from 29).

conventions.lydiaDesignSystem: This Figma file has 'Lydia' (Components/Foundations/Patterns/Lo-Fi Kit) as its linked design system library — it's the source of the colors/typography/component tokens get_design_context has been returning all along. 'Follow Lydia strictly' means: use the exact hex/font values design context returns rather than approximating, and prefer existing shared.css classes/tokens (already extracted from Lydia) over inventing new ones.
conventions.stageConsolidationPattern: Where several Figma frames are really just different states of one screen, they're built as ONE HTML file with .stage/.stage.active panels (or a live form with real toggles/selects) switched by inline <script>, never separate page navigations. Used in: wizard-forward-email.html, wizard-login-credentials.html, wizard-enroll-accounts.html, pp-confirm-address.html, pp-payment-rules.html, invoice-detail.html.
conventions.manageMenuHoverOnly: The 'Manage' side-card's non-active items (Validated credentials, Credentials pending, Priority Payments-shortcut, Errors, Notifications, Requested Providers) are decorative: <span class="nav-item"> with the existing :hover CSS, no href/onclick. This applies on both home-empty.html and home-connected.html. Do NOT confuse this with the top TABS strip on home-connected.html, which is a different element and remains fully functional.
